why: A 2026 arXiv preprint 'An improved lower bound for Bloch's constant' reports a computer-assisted proof improving the lower bound to sqrt(3)/4 + 0.0153, superseding prior bounds by Chen-Gauthier and Xiong; the exact value remains open but the bound on the constant itself moved.
